caption: The drawing depicts a single light blue dress, centered on an off-white background. The dress has a round neckline, short puffed sleeves with cuffs, and a fitted bodice that extends to a gathered, full skirt. Decorative vertical and horizontal seam details are present, including a zigzag pattern on the seams around the waist, down the front of the skirt, and near the hem and sleeve cuffs. Shading and contour lines accentuate the folds and texture of the fabric, enhancing depth. There are some faint brownish spots and marks visible on the background. The artist's signature, "Edith Ebener," appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Boy's Dress
